other_cash_flow.note: Document-only forecast is the official BASE. The going-concern overlay uses the historical median NET treasury flow (all_net), never gross external_out, which mixes internal transfers and already-counted AP.

going_concern_overlay.note: Adds the historical median NET treasury flow as a going-concern overlay (LOW confidence), never gross external_out.

FC02_projected_ar_open_at_cutoff.basis: Every AR event comes from an OINV with DocStatus='O', CANCELED='N' and open balance > 0.

FC03_projected_ap_open_at_cutoff.basis: Every AP event comes from an OPCH with DocStatus='O', CANCELED='N' and open balance > 0.

FC04_no_post_cutoff_documents_in_backtes.basis: Backtest predictions only use documents with DocDate<=cutoff; later settlements are used only to measure outcomes.

FC05_no_ap_po_double_count.basis: Open AP invoices (OPCH) and open PO commitments (OPOR/POR1) are disjoint document universes; no PO is added when an AP invoice already exists.

FC06_no_orct_odps_double_count.basis: Forecast cash-in uses contractual open AR (OINV), never ORCT/ODPS deposits; deposits are internal transfers and excluded.

FC07_internal_transfers_not_external_cas.basis: Only AR/AP/PO documents feed the forecast; internal treasury transfers are outside the model.

FC08_fx_accounting_only_not_cash.basis: Amounts use document currency (DocTotalFC for USD AP/PO); FX revaluation is not a cash event.

FC09_currencies_not_summed_nominally.basis: BS and USD are projected in separate ladders; SC_ONLY treasury is reported separately and never consolidated.

FC10_expected_collections_reproducible.basis: Every expected collection carries rule, level and percentile.

FC11_expected_payments_reproducible.basis: Every expected payment carries rule, level and percentile.

FC12_scenario_assumptions_explicit.basis: Each scenario stores its collection/payment/recovery/overlay parameters.

FC13_backtest_no_leakage.basis: Delay distributions used in a cutoff only include settlements before that cutoff.

FC14_forecast_coverage_measured.basis: AR expected/open and AP+PO open/full are reported per currency and horizon.

FC15_unresolved_quantified.basis: Unrecovered overdue AR is quantified explicitly.

FC17_ar_expected_within_open.basis: Expected AR collections cannot exceed the contractual open AR balance.

FC18_ap_projected_in_full.basis: Every open AP document is projected to be paid in full in its own currency.

FC19_currency_separation.basis: Each scenario exposes independent BS and USD ladders; SC_ONLY is never consolidated.

limitations: Forecast is document-driven: it projects only open AR, open AP and open PO existing at the cutoff.
No new sales, payroll, tax or CAPEX beyond known open documents (DEGRADED per gate rules).
STARTING_SAP_TREASURY_POSITION is an accounting position; no external bank statement reconciliation exists.
WHT projection remains degraded and is excluded.
SC_ONLY treasury is not nominally comparable and is excluded from consolidated liquidity.
Recovery curves assume historical behaviour repeats; matured-cohort survivors are excluded from settled histograms.

About half of the 90-day AP outflow is FINANCING (bank suppliers, mostly overdue); SAP stores it as open invoices without an installment schedule, so the model treats it as payable. Excluding financing, the document-driven 90-day BS position is positive.
